title: Helms Club: secret consciousness study group with Francis Crick

tellings.quote: I I spent a lot of time with Francis Crick, the the guy who discovered the structure of DNA. He he and a a small group of us at UC Irvine called the Helm's Club met for almost 20 years secretly studying consciousness.

plain: The cognitive scientist Donald Hoffman tells Michels that he spent a lot of time with Francis Crick, the co-discoverer of the structure of DNA, in a small group at UC Irvine in California called the Helms Club. He says the group met in secret for almost 20 years to study consciousness. He was a member himself, and he gives it to show that leading scientists took the question seriously, though out of view.
